# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs_gmxselect

## Summary

Wrapper of the GROMACS select module.

The GROMACS select module writes out basic data about dynamic selections. It can be used for some simple analyses, or the output can be combined with output from other programs and/or external analysis programs to calculate more complex things.

Nextflow adapter of the [Gmxselect](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.gmxselect) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_GMXSELECT } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs_gmxselect'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_GMXSELECT(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_structure_path` | yes | pdb, gro, tpr | Path to the input GRO/PDB/TPR file |
| `input_ndx_path` | no | ndx | Path to the input index NDX file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>.<role>.<extension>`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_ndx_path` | yes | ndx | Path to the output index NDX file |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Gmxselect properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension (for example `[output_ndx_path: 'ndx']`). Optional outputs set to `false` are not requested |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_GMXSELECT' {
        ext.properties = [selection: 'a CA C N O']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | string | "a CA C N O" | Heavy atoms. Atom selection string. |
| `append` | boolean | false | Append the content of the input_ndx_path to the output_ndx_path. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `gmx_lib` | string | null | Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
